snippet.title: Slaughter Void First Trailer
snippet.description:
SLAUGHTER VOID is a brutal, high intensity hack and slash, combining the best of speed running and action RPGs with fast-paced combat, varied weapons, and of course loot. An homage to the classic, blood spattered fantasy of the 70's and 80's, SLAUGHTER VOID is a stylish, vicious, and uncompromising experience with an emphasis on speed.

Die fast. Kill faster. 

Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333980/Slaughter_Void/
